headline: Your computer may still have years left.
body: Dagric OS is designed for people moving a working PC to a supported, familiar desktop.
voiceScript: Windows 10 support ended, but your computer may still have years left. Dagric OS gives a working PC a supported, familiar desktop you can try before installing.

kicker: What the installed OS sends us
headline: No product telemetry. No crash reports.
body: Update and firmware checks are documented separately in the privacy policy.
voiceScript: Dagric OS sends no product analytics, telemetry, or crash reports to Dagric. Update checks and optional services are documented separately in the privacy policy.

headline: No Dagric account required.
body: The desktop works without asking a server for permission. There is no Dagric advertising ID.

headline: Ask the USB about your actual hardware.
body: Check This PC reports on networking, graphics, sound, firmware, storage, battery, camera, and printers.
cta: Nothing is installed while it checks
voiceScript: Before installing, open Check This PC from the live USB. It reviews networking, graphics, sound, firmware, storage, and other essentials without changing your disk.

kicker: A live desktop, not a sales demo
headline: Use Dagric before you install it.
body: Browse, open files, test Wi-Fi, and inspect the desktop while Windows remains untouched on the disk.
cta: Remove the USB to return to Windows

headline: Windows is read, never rewritten.
body: Migration Assistant copies selected folders and prepares bookmarks while mounting the Windows partition read-only.
voiceScript: Migration Assistant finds your Windows folders, copies only what you choose, and prepares browser bookmarks. The Windows partition is mounted read-only throughout the process.

headline: Search, favorites, and shutdown are where you expect.
body: A familiar launcher lowers the learning curve without pretending the desktop is Windows.

headline: Drivers, printers, security, layouts, and guides.
body: Dagric Hub groups the common owner tasks in one window instead of scattering them across forum posts.

kicker: The path is named up front
headline: Seven installer steps. Review before writing.
body: Welcome, location, keyboard, partitions, users, summary, and install—the summary is your final checkpoint.
voiceScript: The installer names all seven steps up front. Review the disk, partitions, users, and final summary carefully before anything is written.

headline: Btrfs is selected. Encryption is a checkbox.
body: The default filesystem supports snapshots; full-disk encryption remains an explicit choice during installation.

headline: Choose a snapshot from the boot menu.
body: On the default Btrfs installation, Dagric creates snapshots before updates so an earlier state remains available.
voiceScript: On the default Btrfs installation, Dagric takes snapshots before updates. If an update causes trouble, choose an earlier snapshot from the boot menu.

headline: Updates can install without hijacking your restart.
body: Security updates install automatically; you choose when the computer reboots.

headline: Seven layouts, one set of files and apps.
body: Three layouts ship with Free and four more with Pro. Change the arrangement without rebuilding your workspace.
cta: Pick the layout that feels right

headline: Free means free—no account and no expiration.
body: The Free edition includes the private desktop, Hub, hardware check, migration tools, rollback, and everyday applications.

headline: Pro is not a subscription.
body: Pro adds the curated creator, gaming, developer, and Windows-app stack with updates included.
voiceScript: Dagric Pro is a one-time thirty-nine dollar purchase for one machine, not a subscription. It adds curated creator, gaming, developer, and Windows-app tools.

kicker: Keep the app you still need
headline: Install Bottles from the Hub on either edition.
body: Many Windows programs run in separate containers. Compatibility still depends on the individual application.
cta: Check the app, not just the logo

headline: Steam, Heroic, Proton, and Bottles have a home in the Hub.
body: Free provides one-click helpers; Pro adds a tuned gaming and Wine runtime already installed.

headline: Create with open tools instead of assembling them one by one.
body: Pro groups a tested set of graphics, audio, video, publishing, and media utilities for creators.
cta: See the exact Pro package list

headline: Containers, editors, databases, and language tools—curated together.
body: Pro adds a developer stack while the Debian base remains available to every edition.

headline: Checksums are published and GPG-signed.
body: Compare the ISO against SHA256SUMS, then verify that file with the public Dagric signing key.
voiceScript: Before booting an ISO, compare it with the published SHA two-fifty-six checksum. Then verify that checksum file with Dagric's public GPG signing key.

headline: Supported, partially supported, and unsupported are listed separately.
body: Dagric publishes an accessibility conformance report, including known limitations instead of hiding them.
voiceScript: Dagric publishes an accessibility conformance report that separates supported, partially supported, and unsupported behavior. Known limitations are listed instead of hidden.

kicker: When the guide is not enough
headline: A support page, bug form, and human email route.
body: Common fixes are public, and support messages can be sent through the site or to support at dagric dot com.

headline: Secure Boot and legacy BIOS are both supported paths.
body: The live USB is the fastest way to confirm the exact firmware and hardware combination on your machine.

headline: Debian 13 underneath. KDE Plasma on the desktop.
body: Dagric integrates, configures, hardens, and supports established open-source components rather than hiding the foundation.

headline: Upgrade in place without reinstalling.
body: Buy Pro, open Dagric Hub, paste the receipt code, and keep the existing files and settings.
voiceScript: You can start with Dagric Free and decide later. A purchased Pro license upgrades the installed system through Dagric Hub while keeping your existing files and settings.
